purpose: Evidence-driven chain-by-chain expansion after Polygon P11 closure.
rules: Do not treat the universe as permanently fixed at 28 chains.
A chain enters active research only after candidate evidence is recorded.
Chain closure requires the same P2-P11 fail-closed evidence discipline used for Polygon.

completed.note: Polygon census/audit closure is complete; exact profitability remains explicitly residual.
Ethereum P2 infrastructure/control evidence is closed from current-main CI artifacts. P3 discovery is the next stage; no protocol/pool/profitability claim is implied.

queue_policy: After Ethereum, order is recalculated from fresh evidence rather than permanently hard-coded.
